intents.message: Set NEAR_INTENTS_JWT from the Explorer Partner Dashboard to fetch per-swap activity.

limitations: Imported from BigQuery console exports of the versioned SQL, not queried by this script. Re-run with `make rebuild` under your own Google Cloud project to reproduce.

Daily signer and transaction counts equal NearBlocks exactly in every comparable week, which indicates NearBlocks counts the same quantities from the same chain. That confirms the aggregator's numbers; it is not a second, differently-defined measurement.
Contract usage keeps the top 25 contracts per day, so multi-day totals are lower bounds.
